lines.q: How many legs does an insect have?
lines.a: Six! Spiders have eight, so they're not insects.

lines.q: In which country is the Taj Mahal?
lines.a: India! In the city of Agra.

lines.q: Which planet is famous for its rings?
Mix blue and yellow paint. What colour do you get?
What is the square root of one hundred forty four?
Last one. Who painted The Starry Night?
lines.a: Vincent van Gogh! Think you can get all six? Go again!
